import sys

sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)

def go(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    k = 1
    cnt = 1
    while k * 10 + 1 < n:
        k = k * 10 + 1
        cnt += 1
    option1 = go(n % k) + (n // k) * cnt
    option2 = go((k * 10 + 1 - n) % k) + (cnt + 1) + ((k * 10 + 1 - n) // k) * cnt
    return min(option1, option2)

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not data:
        return
    n = abs(int(data))
    print(go(n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
